topic: Load-shedding: Chacha Jee tries to fix the UPS himself and becomes the hero of the street, almost.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ka UPS: Mohallay Ke Hero, Taqreeban!

shots.narration: چچا بولے، آج پورا محلہ مجھے دعائیں دے گا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright Pakistani house entrance opening onto an empty sunny street, 3D animated comedy film look. An enclosed UPS and a stationary pedestal fan stand beside the doorway. No visible text or markings.
shots.action: Chacha raises a triumphant fist beside the silent fan while Pappu watches with raised eyebrows.
shots.mood: Warm golden sunlight, exaggerated confidence, playful anticipation.

shots.narration: بجلی گئی، اور یو پی ایس بھی خاموش!
shots.scene: Same sunny entrance, enclosed UPS with a dark indicator and pedestal fan with motionless blades, no exposed wires or readable markings.
shots.action: Pappu fans his sweaty face with his hand.
shots.mood: Bright summer heat, flushed cheeks, comic discomfort.

shots.narration: چچا نے مرمت شروع کی، کپڑے سے!
shots.scene: Same entrance, closed UPS casing beside the stationary fan, warm Pakistani home interior behind them, no text.
shots.action: Chacha proudly polishes the closed UPS casing with a yellow cloth.
shots.mood: Grand heroic posture contrasted with an ordinary cleaning cloth.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، پہلے یہ بٹن تو دبا لیں!
shots.scene: Close view of the closed UPS at the house entrance, one large unmarked external power button clearly visible, no exposed components.
shots.action: Pappu points patiently at the external power button.
shots.mood: Patient little smile, Chacha's stubbornly confident expression.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، یہی تو میری اگلی چال تھی!
shots.scene: Same house entrance, enclosed UPS beside the pedestal fan, no lettering or symbols.
shots.action: Chacha presses the UPS external power button with a theatrical flourish.
shots.mood: Raised moustache, puffed chest, Pappu's knowing smile.

shots.narration: پنکھا چلا، چچا محلے کے ہیرو بن گئے!
shots.scene: View from the sunny empty street toward the entrance, pedestal fan spinning beside the powered UPS, Chacha's waistcoat fluttering gently, no signs or text.
shots.action: Chacha waves grandly toward the empty street.
shots.mood: Mock victory parade, warm sunlight, delighted self-importance.

shots.narration: بس، بیٹری کی ہمت اتنی ہی تھی!
shots.scene: Same entrance moments later, UPS indicator dark again, pedestal fan completely stopped, Chacha's waistcoat hanging still.
shots.action: Chacha slowly lowers his triumphant waving hand.
shots.mood: Sudden comic silence, frozen smile, Pappu's sympathetic expression.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، یہ والا کبھی بند نہیں ہوتا!
shots.scene: Same bright entrance, silent electrical fan and closed UPS in the background, Chachi holding a colourful woven hand fan without lettering.
shots.action: Chachi places the woven hand fan into Chacha's open hand.
shots.mood: Chachi's victorious sweet smile, Chacha's wide-eyed realization.

shots.narration: ہیرو اب پنکھا جھلیں گے، اگلی بار فریج کی باری!
shots.scene: Bright sitting area just inside the same entrance, Chachi reclining comfortably in a cane chair, Pappu seated nearby, a plain closed refrigerator visible in the adjoining kitchen, no text or branding.
shots.action: Chacha dutifully fans Chachi with the woven hand fan.
shots.mood: Chachi comfortably triumphant, Chacha maintaining heroic dignity, Pappu grinning

episode.endHook: Agli baar Chacha Jee fridge ko thanda karna sikhaenge!
episode.description: بجلی گئی تو چچا جی یو پی ایس ٹھیک کرنے نکل پڑے! محلے کے ہیرو بنتے بنتے، چاچی جان نے انہیں بالکل نئی ڈیوٹی دے دی۔
